network_metric.run_species_pool: union of distinct positively calling species across all 10 sampled stops
network_metric.pair_trials: all unordered pairs among the run species pool = choose(S,2)
network_metric.pair_successes: unordered species pairs observed positively calling together at >=1 of the same 10 stops

primary_predictor.interpretation: recent rainfall is associated with denser within-run co-calling networks conditional on the species pool present during that run

model_family: binomial_logit with pair_trials as frequency weights
support_rule: beta_rain < 0 and two-sided cluster-robust p < 0.05 and 95% CI excludes 0

sensitivity.name: exclude_pair_successes_seen_at_only_one_stop
sensitivity.rule: pair is a success only if it co-calls at >=2 of 10 stops
sensitivity.interpretation: tests whether rainfall signal reflects repeated within-run network overlap rather than one-stop coincidences

forbidden: no edge chosen by effect size
no species subset chosen after opening
no threshold on DaysSinceRain chosen after opening
